decisions.reason: As a visible 2018 launch on its own page that extends the firm's core workplace and flexible-interior direction, management is likely to continue backing it and interpret any early weakness as temporary.
This chair family is close to the established offer and was publicly presented as a standalone product, so sunk development effort and portfolio fit make withdrawal unlikely after only one year.
Although more peripheral than core furniture lines, it was still given its own page and can be justified as part of a broader lifestyle interior concept, which encourages continued commitment.

The sofa fits the firm's existing upholstered interior business, and despite weaker public emphasis on the website, management would likely retain it because it supports the announced move toward complete interior solutions.

The high standing table is close to the firm's established office and conference offering and received a dedicated presentation, so management is likely to keep supporting it rather than admit an early reversal.

This rug collection is more distant from the traditional core and therefore somewhat easier to cut, but its dedicated launch and relevance to internationally oriented, natural interior concepts still favor keeping it for now.
